model.title: A resolution recognizing September 15, 2026, as "National Voter Registration Day".

summary.text: The resolution recognizes September 15, 2026, as National Voter Registration Day and encourages eligible citizens of the United States to register to vote, to check with their state or local election official that their personal information on record is current, and to go to the polls on election day and vote if they wish to do so.
